cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Replies are short and natural, lead with the answer, give the cause and restoration time, and end with the prescribed goodbye. English-led Taglish fits the caller; "Verified na po kayo" is slightly more Tagalog than the style's set phrases but still reads as natural call-center speech.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber. This is Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po, magandang umaga. Ano po, wala pong internet yung bahay namin since kaninang umaga pa. Gusto ko lang pong malaman kung bakit at kailan po babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that po. May I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of your registered mobile number so I can verify your account?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, yung account number ko po is 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number ko po ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you po. Sandali lang po, let me verify your account.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Maria. Let me check your area for outages now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: There's an outage in your area, Maria, caused by a fiber cable cut along Batasan Road during road works. Service is expected back by 11:30 PM tonight.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ah, ganun po ba, na-cut po pala yung fiber cable. Sige po, salamat po sa info, hihintayin ko na lang po hanggang 11:30 ng gabi. Salamat po ulit, paalam na po!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: You're welcome po, Maria. Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber.
